title: W kawiarni
description: Zamów kawę i coś do jedzenia, zapytaj o ceny i Wi-Fi.
ai_role: a friendly barista in a busy coffee shop in London
learner_role: a customer ordering a drink and a snack
goal: Order politely, ask at least one question and pay.

title: Small talk
description: Luźna rozmowa ze znajomym z pracy przy ekspresie do kawy.
ai_role: a cheerful colleague from another team, chatting by the coffee machine
learner_role: a colleague having a casual chat
goal: Keep a natural small-talk conversation going: weekend, plans, hobbies.

title: Spotkanie online w pracy
description: Krótki status projektu na callu. Zadawaj pytania, dopytuj, ustal kolejne kroki.
ai_role: a project manager running a short online status meeting
learner_role: a team member giving an update and asking questions
goal: Give a short update, ask for clarification once and agree on next steps.

title: U lekarza
description: Opisz objawy, odpowiedz na pytania lekarza i dopytaj o leczenie.
ai_role: a calm general practitioner during an appointment
learner_role: a patient who has not been feeling well
goal: Describe symptoms, answer questions and understand the advice.

title: W hotelu
description: Zameldowanie, problem z pokojem i pytanie o śniadanie.
ai_role: a hotel receptionist at the front desk
goal: Check in, report one problem with the room and ask about breakfast.

title: Pytanie o drogę
description: Zgubiłeś się w nowym mieście. Zapytaj o drogę i upewnij się, że rozumiesz.
ai_role: a helpful local on the street
learner_role: a tourist who is a bit lost
goal: Ask for directions, check that you understood and thank the person.

title: Rozmowa o pracę
description: Opowiedz o sobie, swoim doświadczeniu i zadaj pytania rekruterowi.
ai_role: a friendly recruiter interviewing a candidate
goal: Introduce yourself, describe your experience and ask one question about the job.

title: Temat dowolny
description: Rozmowa na dowolny temat. Zacznij od tego, o czym chcesz porozmawiać.
goal: Talk about any topic the learner chooses and keep the conversation going.
